Xerath

the Magus Ascendant
Mid laneSupport lane

Xerath support pokes the enemy bot lane from very far away. His long range, stun and slow let him win trades and set up kills, and his ultimate can finish enemies across the map. Pick him if you love landing skill shots and want to play an aggressive support.

When to pick Xerath

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Not ideal. Engage supports like Rell can catch him easily.

Pick into

  • Immobile supports he can out-range, like Lux and Seraphine
  • Slow supports, like Swain
  • Teams without much engage
  • Siege games where poke matters

Avoid into

  • Engage supports, like Rell
  • Healing supports, like Nami and Sona
  • Teams with lots of dive
  • Teams with lots of healing

Great teammates

XayahHer root combos with your stun.
JhinHis long range pairs well with your poke.
AsheHer slows set up your skill shots.

Your team needs: Pick Xerath support when your team has a frontline and your ADC can follow up on poke.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Huge range: pokes the enemy bot lane before they can touch him
  • Stun and slow set up kills for his ADC
  • Rite of the Arcane can finish enemies from across the map
  • Strong damage for a support

Weaknesses

  • Immobile: engage supports can catch him easily
  • Doesn't protect his ADC much
  • All his damage comes from skill shots
  • Weak if the enemy can reach him

Power spikes

  • Level 2: W and Q unlocked. Poke the enemy bot lane hard.
  • Level 3: E unlocked. You can set up kills with the stun.
  • Level 6: Rite of the Arcane lets you finish enemies from far away.
  • Support item upgrade (Zaz'Zak's Realmspike): free through the support quest, extra poke damage.
  • First item (Luden's Echo): your poke hurts a lot.

Top tips

  • Don't take your ADC's last hits. Poke the enemy champions instead.
  • Use your quest's cheap control wards to keep the river warded.
  • Save E for engage supports who dive you.
  • Poke the enemy bot lane with W into Q.
  • Use your ultimate to finish low enemies anywhere on the map.
  • Stay behind your frontline in teamfights.
